on_image_text: When I say I want to do life with you, I mean:
I want to take turns brewing coffee every morning.
I want to make grocery lists with you every week.

I want to wander aimlessly
through farmers’ markets with you.
I want to wash the dishes while you dry them.

I want to slow dance in the kitchen,
just because.

I want to fold laundry while we
toss socks at each other.
